Mac:space-quest-3.d: Space Quest III: The Pirates of Pestulon is graphic adventure game developed and published by Sierra On-Line. Players assume the role of Roger Wilco, a lowly space janitor, who becomes involved in rescuing a pair of programmers from a sinister video game company. The game received positive reviews from critics, and contributed further to the series' commercial success for Sierra.
